senses.definition: (used of conduct or character) deserving or bringing disgrace or shame
examples: Man … has written one of his blackest records as a destroyer on the oceanic islands
an opprobrious monument to human greed

senses.definition: in a dishonorable manner or to a dishonorable degree
the lack of knowledge or education
unaware because of a lack of relevant information or knowledge
examples: he was completely ignorant of the circumstances

senses.definition: uneducated in general; lacking knowledge or sophistication
examples: an unlearned group incapable of understanding complex issues
exhibiting contempt for his unlettered companions

senses.definition: uneducated in the fundamentals of a given art or branch of learning; lacking knowledge of a specific field
examples: she is ignorant of quantum mechanics

senses.definition: give little or no attention to

examples: She cut him dead at the meeting
